opening.argument: The video frames the interaction as an investigation into a purported GoPro-support scam, beginning with the explicit title "Weird GoPro Tech Support Scam Exposed" and the statement that "this is not the official gopro support." The $149.99 charge, potentially harmful file, PayPal request, and password-related questions are presented as conduct being challenged and tested, not as services being promoted. The caller specifically asks, "Is that why you opened up my passwords text file like seven times?" A visible "Granny Guard Activated" dialog with a masked password field and a connection-failure message further supplies the staged or investigative context. Taken together, the presentation exposes and criticizes the support solicitation rather than endorsing it.
